title: Understanding Bootstrapping
text: Bootstrapping involves resampling with replacement from the sample data to create many simulated samples. This helps in estimating the sampling distribution of a statistic.

title: Sample Size in Bootstrapping
text: When performing bootstrapping, each resampled dataset should have the same size as the original sample. Consider how many individuals are in the original sample.
